title: Execution of an Appended Gate
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $x$ assign an element of $R$ to each of $n$ input variables, let $gs$ be a finite list of arithmetic gates, and let $g$ be an arithmetic gate. Running the list formed by appending $g$ to $gs$ gives the values from running $gs$, followed by the value of $g$ evaluated using those values.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns a ring element to each of the $n$ input variables
$gs$ is a finite list of arithmetic gates
